details.pr_title: Persist idempotency key before first capture

data.text:
I reviewed PR #481 in acme/payments-api. It's titled "Persist idempotency key before first capture" by jordan, a small change of +14 -3 confined to payments/retry.py, and the body describes carrying the idempotency key across the retry so the network cannot double-capture. That directly targets the double-charge-on-retry bug, and CI checks are passing. Because the PR was unambiguous and the checks were conclusive, I did not need to consult the #payments Slack discussion.

I attempted the merge to deploy the fix, but Scope denied the merge_pr call on behalf of hiva@acme.com, so the PR is still open and unmerged. I did not retry it. Nothing is blocking on the code side: the fix is reviewed and green, it just needs someone with merge authority to approve or grant that capability, after which #481 can be merged to master to deploy.
